name: prof-f06-sony — extracted from f06-sony
palette: Neutral, sunlit urban base (grays, beiges, muted greens) overrun by high-saturation candy colors (red, yellow, blue, pink) that gradually dominate the frame.
light_logic: Consistent bright midday hard sunlight with clear blue sky; no change in time-of-day, so the emotional shift is carried purely by motion and color density.
lens: Moderate wide lenses for steep street vistas and environmental context, mixed with medium and low-angle shots that let particles fill the foreground and sky; minimal distortion, grounded realism.
texture: Crisp, clean digital image with sharp edges on particles and hard shadows; the ‘softness’ comes from motion blur and density of moving specks rather than from filtration.
world: Recognizable, unstyled residential city streets—cars, poles, wires, signage—treated as a realistic stage that becomes surreal only through the invading storm of color.
forbidden: Cutting away to faces or character drama that would compete with the pure environmental spectacle
Changing weather or time-of-day to signal emotion instead of using the particle event
Heavy VFX gloss that breaks the grounded, photographic feel of a real street
Complex narrative exposition or dialogue that explains the phenomenon
Multiple unrelated visual motifs that dilute the single-color-swarm identity
